text:
Maya (Support): Hi team — Acme Corp reports Azure marketplace accelerator credits not showing in their Redwood billing/console. They gave grant id `AZ-GRANT-9f2a` and marketplace entitlement id `ent-0a12b`. They say credits landed in their Azure portal but balance is 0 in our UI. Ticket #SUP-4821.

Liam (Partnerships): Could be tenant mismatch. Do we have the customer's Azure tenant ID and subscription id? Also check whether the marketplace webhook for that grant was processed.

Maya (Support): Tenant ID `72f988bf-86f1-41af-91ab-2d7cd011db47`, subscription `sub-9a8b7c`. I pasted the Azure invoice and their reply in the ticket. They said the purchase flow went through yesterday ~15:10 UTC.

Adrian (Finance): Logged. Quick check of ledger: I don't see any credit posted to account `acct-ACME-01`. Looks like the entitlement was never mapped to our internal customer id. Could be webhook delivery failure or mapping table missing.

Ryan (SRE): Poking logs: webhook handler returned 422 for `ent-0a12b` at 2026-04-13T15:10:32Z with message `subscription not linked`. In our system the mapping key uses `azure_subscription_id` and we have `sub-9a8b7c` mapped to `acct-ACME-OLD` (legacy onboarding). That explains mismatch.

Maya (Support): Ah — Acme said they recently migrated subscriptions between tenants as part of consolidation. They expected Redwood credits to follow.

Liam (Partnerships): For marketplace grants we have to replay the marketplace entitlement webhook after fixing mapping. Steps: 1) confirm correct customer account id, 2) add mapping for `sub-9a8b7c -> acct-ACME-01`, 3) run entitlement replay job `tools/marketplace/replay_entitlement --id ent-0a12b --force`. Ryan, can you do mapping + replay?

Ryan (SRE): On it. I will add mapping in `db.marketplace_subscription_mappings` and then trigger replay.

billing-bot: Replay job queued: job-id `replay-7832`. ETA ~2m.

Ryan (SRE): Ran `UPDATE marketplace_subscription_mappings SET account_id='acct-ACME-01' WHERE subscription_id='sub-9a8b7c';` then executed `tools/marketplace/replay_entitlement --id ent-0a12b --force` — webhook processed, acceptance status 200. Logs: `credit_applied: 3000USD, ledger_tx: tx-5591`.

Adrian (Finance): I see `tx-5591` in ledger now, credits posted and available balance updated. Please confirm customer sees it.

Maya (Support): Messaging Acme now.

Maya (Support): They confirm balances are visible in UI and their SDK token calls reflect increased credit. They were able to run test job. :tada:

Liam (Partnerships): Root cause summary for ticket: subscription was migrated between tenants and our subscription->account mapping still pointed to legacy account. Fix: updated mapping and replayed entitlement webhook. Action items: (1) Partnerships to document migration guidance for customers, (2) Support to flag similar tickets for tenant migrations, (3) Engineering to add webhook dead-letter alert when mapping not found.

Adrian (Finance): Adding invoice note and closing provisional hold.

support-bot: Ticket SUP-4821 status changed -> resolved by Maya.

Maya (Support): Closing thread. If we want a postmortem doc, happy to draft a short runbook for on-call.
